**Bottom line:** Expect a roughly 9‑hour drive covering about 520 miles, using around 21 gallons of fuel and costing roughly $70–$80, assuming normal traffic and a typical midsize sedan. Enjoy the scenic stretch of I‑80 and the golden light of Reno!
